scope: Finite connected undirected simple (q+1)-regular graphs, q>0; q>1 for u=q^-s and graph RH. Constants and bipartite alternating direction removed. H positive semidefinite iff all |lambda|<=2sqrt(q), positive definite iff strict; boundary Jordan modes cannot be silently quotiented while retaining all responses. Mixed-cycle lemma only for fixed nonnegative path weights and uncompensated ordinary logdet with prime-power-only support. No Riemann zeta source identification, infinite all-place positivity, speedup or TOE claim.
